name: Inisiatif agent, kelanjutan tugas, pemulihan dan bukti selesai
meaning: Internal bounded acceptance level, not a general intelligence certification

roles.Codex: implementation, isolated grading, regression fixes and activation

scope.native_client: isolated Cline using configured Harmonika public provider

implemented: Task-local observations preserve unfinished operations and original intent through internal compaction.
Unknown mutation outcomes require original-ID reconciliation; no repeat with replacement idempotency key.
Repeated unchanged reads/status are bounded; choose a useful alternate diagnostic or report a real blocker.
Every recognized edited file requires fresh matching readback or a current passing test; stale, zero and count-less results cannot establish explicit test completion.
Operator-signed allowed_tools only narrows caller declarations; rejected scope/schema requests do not leak model admission slots.
Known native Cline clipped command display correlates only to a unique original prefix and exact removed length.
Agent instructions choose discovery, correction, verification and grounded progress within authorized scope instead of ending at a promise.

baseline.type: synthetic checker probe; no live model or tool execution

backend_exam.execution: isolated synthetic fixture executor; separate protected assertions and bounded independent verifier
backend_exam.sqlite_reconciliation: R05/R06/E05 seeded one real commit; model submitted zero duplicates; fresh process readback confirmed exactly one effect. Initial commit was operator-seeded, not a model action.
backend_exam.cancel: own fixture worker physically stopped via flag, checked separately; no signals to user processes

issues_found_and_corrected.issue: First lost-ACK fixture referenced a committed job with no actual seeded DB record.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Seed real SQLite commit and record readback/effect count; preserve first failure.

issues_found_and_corrected.issue: Job fixtures contained unrelated broken application code; agent pursued irrelevant work.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Restrict job fixtures to task-relevant data and enforce operator-signed tool scope.

issues_found_and_corrected.issue: New schema/scope rejection could retain an active slot before spawning model.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Validate before admission; regression sends 12 rejections then a valid request; release setup failures.

issues_found_and_corrected.issue: Initial native fallback fixed code and passed tests, but long Cline display queries lost receipt correlation and CLI returned invalid_tool_response.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Rollback verified healthy; add unique prefix/length binder regression; rerun all 18 missions and three native cases before accepting release.

issues_found_and_corrected.issue: HTTP helper callback syntax and attestation target hash length initially blocked postchecks.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Correct helpers, preserve initial failures and rerun against actual state.

dispositions.finding: build-only or count-less receipts could satisfy test requirement
dispositions.resolution: exclude build from test executors; require correlated positive count and passing result

dispositions.finding: terminal lookup could borrow job ID from input args
dispositions.resolution: require original identity confirmed by result body; conflicting IDs fail

dispositions.finding: failed test could be masked by later read and polite request prefix
dispositions.resolution: latest explicit failed test blocks completion independent of cited later reads

dispositions.finding: writes could reset unrelated unchanged poll bound
dispositions.resolution: no global poll reset after writes

dispositions.finding: compaction state depends on prepared request identity
dispositions.resolution: document in-memory WeakMap lifetime; caller must retain history, no cross-session database claim

dispositions.finding: ambiguous operations conservatively block same mutator
dispositions.resolution: retain conservative guard; allow known read-only diagnostic and status reconciliation

privacy.reports: technical mechanics, enum/counts and hashes only

limits: Legacy TUI tool receipts remain client_reported, not independent server attestations.
Continuity is request/history-derived memory, not a newly persistent cross-session database; rebuilt external requests need adequate history.
Intent classification is conservative pattern recognition, not universal semantic understanding.
The fixture verifier and native-client instructions are not a general hostile-code sandbox.
HMAC marker contracts are operator proof, not public tenant IAM; executor authorization remains required.
Idle-guarded activation is not an atomic external-admission fence.
Passing these isolated cases does not guarantee every future task succeeds or that hallucinations are impossible.
